method.macd: EMA12 - EMA26 = DIF; EMA9(DIF) = DEA; histogram = 2*(DIF-DEA); EMA initialized at first close, DEA at 0
method.rsi: Wilder RSI14; initial average gain/loss from first 14 close changes; recursive smoothing (previous*13+current)/14; flat series RSI=50
method.weekly: ISO week last available close; 2026-10-16 Friday is a completed week
method.volume: last volume / mean of preceding 5 daily volumes
method.monthly: Calendar month OHLCV aggregated from daily bars; indicators use each month last available close. Completed months through 2026-09, October 2026 is provisional through 2026-10-16. 31 completed monthly bars; initial listing month starts at first available trading day; limited EMA warm-up history.
